items.title: Jurassic Park's T. rex had a real problem
source_notes: Amblin official film page: https://amblin.com/movie/jurassic-park/ — confirms the production combined CGI dinosaurs with full-scale animatronics.

ABC News retrospective: https://abcnews.com/Entertainment/jurassic-park-turns-25-scenes-moments-iconic-summer/story?id=55332468 — reports the rain caused problems for the T. rex animatronic and crew dried it between takes.

scenes.text: Jurassic Park's terrifying T. rex had a surprisingly real problem.
The 1993 film mixed computer-generated dinosaurs with a huge physical animatronic built by Stan Winston's effects team.
During the famous rainstorm scene, water soaked into the dinosaur's skin and caused problems for the mechanism.
The crew had to dry the T. rex between takes. Sometimes, practical movie magic needs a towel.
